summary: Backend testing of Admin Careers panel endpoints (/api/public/careers/*). Built comprehensive pytest suite covering full CRUD lifecycle for job postings and applications, plus validation/edge cases. 27/27 tests PASSED.

minor.issue: Returns 200 on success — convention would be 201 Created, but consistent with rest of project.
No Pydantic model for partial update; relies on request.json() filtering — no validation of field values (e.g., could set is_active to a non-bool). Low risk since admin-only.

Stats are computed only from filtered result set, so when filtering by status='new', stats['reviewed']/'hired' etc. all become 0. Frontend stats pills must call this endpoint without filters to get accurate global counts.
No admin_id/audit trail captured in status update (only updated_at). Consider logging who changed status.
Does not cascade-delete associated job_applications. Orphan applications remain referencing a deleted job_id.

action_items: Consider cascade-deleting job_applications when a job is deleted, OR mark them orphaned (soft-delete).
Frontend: When calling /api/public/careers/applications with status/job filter, global stats pills will be wrong — fetch stats unfiltered once, and use filtered list only for the table.
Optional: add admin_id audit field on PUT /status for traceability.
critical_code_review_comments: Stats computation in list_applications is based on filtered results — misleading when filters applied (see action items).

No authentication check on any /api/public/careers/* admin-facing endpoint (create/update/delete jobs, update status, add note, list applications). Since prefix is 'public', these are callable by anyone. Non-blocking for MVP but should gate with admin PIN/JWT in production.
update_job strips '_id','job_id','created_at','created_by' but allows arbitrary unknown fields to be written into the document — consider whitelist instead of blacklist to keep schema clean.
Resume files saved under /app/backend/uploads/resumes (local disk) — not persistent across container restarts/redeploys. Consider S3/GridFS for production.
job_applications documents lack an 'updated_at' by default (only added when status/note changes); consider adding it at creation for consistency.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@test.com / 153759 (not required — /public/careers/* endpoints have no auth gate)
seed_data_creation: Suite creates TEST_ prefixed jobs + one applicant per run and cleans up jobs. Applications linger (no public delete endpoint) but are TEST_ tagged via unique email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend CRUD for Admin Careers is solid — 27/27 pytest passing. Endpoints live under /api/public/careers (no auth). Known quirk: list_applications stats are post-filter, so frontend should use an unfiltered call for the stats pills. Frontend UI not tested (rate limit bypass issue noted in review_request). Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_careers_crud.py -v
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All create/read/update/delete/toggle/list/filter/status-transition/note/resume-download/validation flows work as expected.
